newsitem.title: UK: UK shares open flat amid advancing futures market.
newsitem.headline: UK shares open flat amid advancing futures market.

text.p: Leading UK shares were nearly unchanged at the start of trading on Thursday as a rising FTSE futures market helped shares recover modest opening losses.
At 0841 GMT, the benchmark FTSE 100 index was up 0.9 point to 4,046.1, while the December FTSE futures contract was up 8.0 to 4,062, putting it at a premium to fair value.
Dealers said they expected low volumes today as the market awaits the release of key U.S. economic figures, due tomorrow, and the UK monetary meeting next week, dealers said.
A slew of company news, including details of British Gas' planned demerger, kept the market occupied early on.
